name: Minecraft_UMA
title: UMA (Minecraft)
original_title: UMA by BirthdayTrain on Planet Minecraft
description: BirthdayTrain's Minecraft UMA converted back into a Titanfall 2 map. Pilot-only preview with baked lighting, torches, spawns and a loading screen.

name: Minecraft_Glitch
title: Glitch (Minecraft)
original_title: Glitch by Oblivering on Planet Minecraft
description: Oblivering's Minecraft Glitch converted back into a Titanfall 2 map. Pilot-only preview with ziplines, a death pit, baked lighting and a loading screen.

name: Quake_E1M1
title: Quake E1M1
original_title: E1M1 by John Romero / id Software (GPL map source)
description: Quake's E1M1, The Slipgate Complex, compiled for Titanfall 2 with LibreQuake textures and baked lighting. Geometry test: no doors, lifts or Quake gameplay.

name: Surf
title: Surf
description: Surf game mode: timed runs, staged maps with in-order checkpoints, uncapped speedometer, saved personal bests, scoreboard leaderboard, optional double jump and optional web leaderboard.

name: Surf_Utopia
title: Surf Utopia
description: Surf Utopia for Titanfall 2. Pilots now stand back up after leaving a ramp or teleporting. Requires Surf mode for timed runs.
original_title: Surf Utopia v3 (original authors credited in-map)

name: Surf_Me
title: Surf Me
description: Surf Me for Titanfall 2: five timed Egyptian-themed stages by not_a_zombie, with stage checkpoints. Requires Surf mode 0.2.0 for timed runs.

name: Surf_Beginner
title: Surf Beginner
description: Seven-stage beginner surf map for Titanfall 2, with its own loading screen and 11 localisations. Requires Surf mode.
